zh: 如果同事不跳过，每一整轮你和同事一共会出掉 a+b 件；真正决定谁出最后一次货的只是最后不到一整轮的那点余量。
把库存化成余数 r（1..a+b）：r≤a 时你直接清空，不需要跳过；否则每让你多出一次都需要同事跳过一次，最少需要 (r-1)//a 次。每个仓库都值 1 分，所以按所需跳过次数从小到大贪心购买。
对每个库存 v 算 cost=((v-1) mod (a+b)) // a；把 cost 排序，依次在跳过预算够用时扣掉 cost 并得 1 分，遇到不够的就停止；输出得分。a+b 可能超过 32 位，用 64 位整数。
en: Without skips, every full round you and your coworker together ship a+b items; who makes the final shipment is decided only by the leftover of less than one full round.

Reduce the stock to a remainder r in 1..a+b: if r <= a you empty it right away with no skips; otherwise every extra shipment of yours needs one coworker skip, so at least (r-1)//a skips are needed. Every warehouse is worth 1 point, so buy points greedily in increasing order of skips needed.

For each stock v compute cost = ((v-1) mod (a+b)) // a; sort the costs and, while the skip budget covers the next cost, subtract it and gain a point, stopping at the first one you cannot afford; print the score. a+b can exceed 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

A full round without skips always consumes a+b. Reduce the stock to a remainder r in 1..a+b; scoring a warehouse needs at least (r-1)//a skips. Sort these costs and buy as many cheap points as possible.

## Correctness

Skips can be postponed to the final stretch that decides who ships last without increasing the number needed. If the remainder r is greater than a, every extra shipment of yours needs one coworker skip, so at least ceil(r/a) - 1 skips are required. Each warehouse independently offers a point of the same value, and swapping a more expensive chosen warehouse with a cheaper unchosen one never lowers the score and never increases the total cost, so taking them in order of cost is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
